info.title: svdgenerator
info.description: Generates typed C++ peripheral headers for ARM Cortex-M targets from a CMSIS-SVD file. The headers are self-contained: strongly-typed, atomic-aware register access with nothing but the standard library.

options.name: --check
options.description:
Write nothing; exit with 3 when <output_dir> is not
what would be generated.

options.name: --force
options.description:
Overwrite a file of the same name that SvdGenerator
did not write.

options.name: --list
options.description:
Write nothing; print the files that would be generated,
one per line, for a build system that wants them as
the outputs of a rule.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show version and exit.
Exit codes: 0 success, 1 error, 2 refused to overwrite, 3 out of date.
